_comment: Zero-shot inference settings. Nothing is trained or tuned. 'source' names where each value comes from.

num_top_results.source: retro and forward: top 10 by user decision. Forward beam size 10 and n_best 10 of the original R-SMILES RtoP translate config and of Chemformer's own evaluation

metrics: top-k and MRR from syntheseus TopKMetricsAccumulator over num_top_results predictions; exact match on syntheseus Reaction equality (canonical SMILES with stereo, reactant bag order-free, reagents ignored); skip_repeats=True
seeds: none: beam search is deterministic. syntheseus set_random_seed(0) is applied as in eval-single-step

retro.notes: Figshare article 23958114, fine-tuned by the syntheseus team on USPTO-50K from the authors' pre-trained checkpoint. beam size = num_top_results (ChemformerModel sets num_beams = num_results).

forward.notes: Authors' fined-tuned/uspto_mixed checkpoint (USPTO-MIT mixed) from https://az.box.com/s/7eci3nd9vy0xplqniitpk02rbg9q2zcq, file last.ckpt,. Beam size = num_top_results = 10.

retro.notes: Figshare article 23960733, released by the authors, USPTO-50K (schneider50k). Template set 'default'.
Figshare article 25047314, released by the authors, USPTO-50K without reaction class. max_edit_steps=9 is the syntheseus default.
Figshare article 23960745, trained by the syntheseus team on USPTO-50K.
Figshare article 23960748, trained by the syntheseus team on USPTO-50K (config.gin: dataset uspto_50k, no reaction type). Kwargs are the syntheseus defaults.
Figshare article 23960766, trained by the syntheseus team on USPTO-50K. Kwargs are the syntheseus defaults.
Figshare article 23960769, trained by the syntheseus team on USPTO-50K (LocalRetro plus kNN datastore).
Figshare article 23960781, released by the authors, USPTO-50K P-to-R. beam 10, translate batch 2048 tokens, max_length 500 from the yml in the checkpoint.

forward.notes: Authors' models/RtoP/USPTO-MIT_RtoP_mixed.pt (Google Drive folder 1c15h6TNU6MSNXzqB6dQVMWOs2Aae8hs6, file id 11T_d3s9ZClxIrJs66ky07asB-0Q-gv-T). Settings from RtoP-MIT-mixed-aug5-translate.yml: beam 10, n_best 10, batch 4096 tokens, max_length 1000, seed 0; augmentation 5 from RtoP-MIT-mixed-aug5-config.yml and the README; score_alpha 1 (score.py default).
